description: List every page in the maker's space, newest first, with no paging: { total, pages: [{ id, title, url, project, views, live, workEmailGated, hasDraft, createdAt, updatedAt }] }. Read-only. Use it to find a page_id before update_page / get_page / unpublish_page / delete_page, or to reuse an existing project name. Offline pages are included (live: false); deleted pages are not. Pass q to search instead of scanning the full list; use get_page when you need one page's HTML.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive search over page titles and content. Omit to list everything.

name: list_pages
title: List pages
